items.title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Commits $750 Billion To US Housing Through 2035
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) has announced a US$750b commitment to support US housing under its American Dream Initiative. The plan runs through 2035 and focuses on financing or preserving one million affordable housing units. The initiative also aims to help 500,000 Americans become homeowners and promote pro growth housing policies.
